text:
sara: Heads-up someone left half a pizza in the fridge with no label. smell is... ambiguous. :pizza:

tim: that was probably from the all-hands last night? I grabbed a slice but left the rest. my bad on no label.

alex: quick rules proposal: any communal leftover must be labelled with name + date + 'FREE' or 'CLAIM' sticky. saves mystery meals.

kitchen-bot: reminder: fridge cleanup is every Monday 4pm. Unlabeled food older than 48 hours will be discarded. See https://redwood.internal/ops/fridge-policy

jess: vote: label + "free" sticker vs disposable takeaway box for communal slices. react :label: for label, :box: for boxes.

tim: :label: cheaper and less waste. i'll put mini post-its by the tape dispenser.

alex: also, can we standardize condiment jars? there's 3 open sriracha bottles and one half-sour mayo museum. maybe a shared condiment shelf with dates.

facilities: we can add a small magnetic rack and a whiteboard marker for dates. will order 1-2 racks and some waterproof labels.

jess: tiny PSA: when doing group food runs, please put the slack thread with who ordered what and the delivery ETA so runners don't get pinged. The order sheet is great.

alex: agree. suggestion: single message format:
```
Order: 4x margherita, 2x salad
Runner: @tim
ETA: 12:40
Pay: Venmo @tim
```

sara: perfect. I'll start tagging "food-run" threads and add the template to pinned messages.

kitchen-bot: inventory update: napkins low, paper plates low, pizza cutter present. update kitchen sheet: https://redwood.internal/kitchen-inventory

tim: outcome: label rule, condiment shelf, food-run template. i'll label the pizza now. apologies to whoever expected a mystery lunch adventure. :laughing:
